entries.author: SSG Richard Hart
entries.note: M270 with the launcher raised: the Bradley-family running gear (six road wheels), the armoured three-man cab at the front, the launcher box with two six-round pods. The A2 keeps this layout with a new cab armour kit.

entries.author: Gertrud Zach
entries.note: Profile on the road, launcher stowed flat over the rear hull.

entries.author: Gertrud Zach
entries.note: Front on: the cab's flat windscreens under armoured shutters, headlights, tow points.

entries.author: Mikko J. Putkonen (Methem)
entries.note: Finnish M270, rear quarter with the launcher raised: the pod faces and the launcher's base.
